chunks: It is narrated from Muʿāwiyah ibn ʿAmmār, who said: Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام said:
“If she received and then passed on, then midwives are more numerous than that. But if she received and raised, she becomes prohibited to him.”

key_terms.رَبَّتْ: she raised or nurtured the child
key_terms.مَرَّتْ: she passed on or moved along without raising

ai.seo_question: When does a woman become prohibited for marriage through receiving and raising a child?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal distinction concerning foster-related prohibition in marriage. Merely handling or receiving the infant does not establish the prohibition, whereas receiving and raising the child does establish a prohibitive relationship.
